method: Get the pan to a medium-high heat and prepare the filling first. Cook the large eggs until just set, keeping it tender rather than hammering it dry.
Add the vegetables and cook until softened but still with a bit of bite. Stir the measured sauce or seasoning through for the final 30–60 seconds so it coats the filling rather than burning.
Warm the wrap for 20–30 seconds so it bends without splitting. Put the filling just below the centre, fold the sides in and roll it up firmly.
For a better finish, put the wrapped seam-side down in the dry pan for a minute to seal and lightly crisp it. Eat while hot.
